name: ESSEC Business School Asia-Pacific
summary: The Singapore campus of a French business school: the four-year English-track Global BBA can start here, then move to Cergy or Rabat.

handoff.label: Global BBA: apply with an international diploma

ib.text: No IB points are published: the file is scored on 3 years of transcripts, a CV and an English test (IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90) unless your last 2 school years were in English, then a 30-minute interview.

dates.label: Round 1 application deadline, noon Paris time
Round 2 application deadline, noon Paris time
Round 3 application deadline, noon Paris time
Round 4 application deadline, noon Paris time
Round 4 interviews run from this date to 26 May
Round 4 final admission results, at the latest

programmes.name: Global BBA
programmes.about: A four-year management degree whose first cycle covers the fundamentals of management; you choose the English Track in Singapore for year 1, and later study at least six months abroad at a partner university.
programmes.ib: English test (IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90, TOEIC 850) unless your last two school years were taught entirely in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Applications are scored as a whole file; shortlisted applicants have a 30-minute motivational interview with two examiners. Rounds run to April 2027.

notes: You choose the Singapore track on the same Global BBA application as Cergy and Rabat; you may apply to a programme once a year and at most twice in total.
A non-refundable deposit of €5,500 for the France and Singapore campuses confirms a place and is taken off the tuition fees.
The fee shown is the EU citizen price for the 2026 intake on the Cergy and Singapore campuses; non-EU citizens pay a higher tuition fee, and the 2027 table is not published yet.

sources.title: ESSEC: Global BBA, applying with an international high school diploma
